verses.original: שַׁאֲל֨וּ מֵיְהוָ֤ה מָטָר֙ בְּעֵ֣ת מַלְק֔וֹשׁ יְהוָ֖ה עֹשֶׂ֣ה חֲזִיזִ֑ים וּמְטַר־ גֶּ֙שֶׁם֙ יִתֵּ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם לְאִ֖ישׁ עֵ֥שֶׂב בַּשָּׂדֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ša·’ă·lū Yah·weh mā·ṭār bə·‘êṯ mal·qō·wōš Yah·weh ‘ō·śeh ḥă·zî·zîm ū·mə·ṭar- ge·šem yit·tên lā·hem lə·’îš ‘ê·śeḇ baś·śā·ḏeh
verses.literal: Ask the LORD for rain in springtime . . . the LORD makes the storm clouds and He will give everyone showers of rain and crops in the field

verses.original: כִּ֧י הַתְּרָפִ֣ים דִּבְּרוּ־ אָ֗וֶן וְהַקּֽוֹסְמִים֙ חָ֣זוּ שֶׁ֔קֶר וַֽחֲלֹמוֹת֙ הַשָּׁ֣וא יְדַבֵּ֔רוּ הֶ֖בֶל יְנַֽחֵמ֑וּן עַל־ כֵּן֙ נָסְע֣וּ כְמוֹ־ צֹ֔אן יַעֲנ֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֵ֥ין רֹעֶֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî hat·tə·rā·p̄îm dib·bə·rū- ’ā·wen wə·haq·qō·ws·mîm ḥā·zū še·qer wa·ḥă·lō·mō·wṯ haš·šå̄·w yə·ḏab·bê·rū he·ḇel yə·na·ḥê·mūn ‘al- kên nā·sə·‘ū ḵə·mōw- ṣōn ya·‘ă·nū kî- ’ên rō·‘eh
verses.literal: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions they tell false dreams and offer empty comfort Therefore . . . the people wander like sheep oppressed for lack of a shepherd

verses.original: עַל־ הָֽרֹעִים֙ חָרָ֣ה אַפִּ֔י וְעַל־ הָעַתּוּדִ֖ים אֶפְק֑וֹד כִּֽי־ פָקַד֩ יְהוָ֨ה צְבָא֤וֹת אֶת־ עֶדְרוֹ֙ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֔ה וְשָׂ֣ם אוֹתָ֔ם כְּס֥וּס הוֹד֖וֹ בַּמִּלְחָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- hā·rō·‘îm ḥā·rāh ’ap·pî wə·‘al- hā·‘at·tū·ḏîm ’ep̄·qō·wḏ kî- p̄ā·qaḏ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ’eṯ- ‘eḏ·rōw ’eṯ- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·śām ’ō·w·ṯām kə·sūs hō·w·ḏōw bam·mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: My anger . . . burns against the shepherds and I will punish the leaders For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock the house of Judah He will make them like His royal steed in battle

verses.original: מִמֶּ֤נּוּ פִנָּה֙ מִמֶּ֣נּוּ יָתֵ֔ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קֶ֣שֶׁת מִלְחָמָ֑ה מִמֶּ֛נּוּ יֵצֵ֥א כָל־ נוֹגֵ֖שׂ יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: mim·men·nū p̄in·nāh mim·men·nū yā·ṯêḏ mim·men·nū qe·šeṯ mil·ḥā·māh mim·men·nū yê·ṣê ḵāl nō·w·ḡêś yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: The cornerstone will come from Judah the tent peg . . . from him as well as the battle . . . . . . bow and every ruler together

verses.original: וְהָי֨וּ כְגִבֹּרִ֜ים בּוֹסִ֨ים בְּטִ֤יט חוּצוֹת֙ בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וְנִ֨לְחֲמ֔וּ כִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה עִמָּ֑ם וְהֹבִ֖ישׁוּ רֹכְבֵ֥י סוּסִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ḵə·ḡib·bō·rîm bō·w·sîm bə·ṭîṭ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ bam·mil·ḥā·māh wə·nil·ḥă·mū kî Yah·weh ‘im·mām wə·hō·ḇî·šū rō·ḵə·ḇê sū·sîm
verses.literal: They will be like mighty men in battle trampling the enemy in the mire of the streets They will fight because the LORD is with them and they will put the horsemen . . . to shame

verses.original: וְגִבַּרְתִּ֣י׀ אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוּדָ֗ה וְאֶת־ בֵּ֤ית יוֹסֵף֙ אוֹשִׁ֔יעַ וְהֽוֹשְׁבוֹתִים֙ כִּ֣י רִֽחַמְתִּ֔ים וְהָי֖וּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ זְנַחְתִּ֑ים כִּ֗י אֲנִ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶעֱנֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡib·bar·tî ’eṯ- bêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh wə·’eṯ- bêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ ’ō·wō·šî·a‘ wə·hō·wō·šə·ḇō·w·ṯîm kî ri·ḥam·tîm wə·hā·yū ka·’ă·šer lō- zə·naḥ·tîm kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem wə·’e·‘ĕ·nêm
verses.literal: I will strengthen the house of Judah and save the house of Joseph I will restore them because I have compassion on them and they will be as though I had not rejected them For I am the LORD their God and I will answer them

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ כְגִבּוֹר֙ אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְשָׂמַ֥ח לִבָּ֖ם כְּמוֹ־ יָ֑יִן וּבְנֵיהֶם֙ יִרְא֣וּ וְשָׂמֵ֔חוּ יָגֵ֥ל לִבָּ֖ם בַּיהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ḵə·ḡib·bō·wr ’ep̄·ra·yim wə·śā·maḥ lib·bām kə·mōw- yā·yin ū·ḇə·nê·hem yir·’ū wə·śā·mê·ḥū yā·ḡêl lib·bām Yah·weh
verses.literal: Ephraim will be like a mighty man and their hearts will be glad as with wine Their children will see it and be joyful their hearts will rejoice in the LORD

verses.original: אֶשְׁרְקָ֥ה לָהֶ֛ם וַאֲקַבְּצֵ֖ם כִּ֣י פְדִיתִ֑ים וְרָב֖וּ כְּמ֥וֹ רָבֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’eš·rə·qāh lā·hem wa·’ă·qab·bə·ṣêm kî p̄ə·ḏî·ṯîm wə·rā·ḇū kə·mōw rā·ḇū
verses.literal: I will whistle for them to gather for I have redeemed them and they will be as numerous as they once were

verses.original: וְאֶזְרָעֵם֙ בָּֽעַמִּ֔ים וּבַמֶּרְחַקִּ֖ים יִזְכְּר֑וּנִי וְחָי֥וּ אֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶ֖ם וָשָֽׁבוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ez·rā·‘êm bā·‘am·mîm ū·ḇam·mer·ḥaq·qîm yiz·kə·rū·nî wə·ḥā·yū ’eṯ- bə·nê·hem wā·šā·ḇū
verses.literal: Though I sow them among the nations they will remember Me in distant lands they and their children will live . . . and return

verses.original: וַהֲשִֽׁיבוֹתִים֙ מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֔יִם וּמֵֽאַשּׁ֖וּר אֲקַבְּצֵ֑ם וְאֶל־ אֶ֨רֶץ גִּלְעָ֤ד וּלְבָנוֹן֙ אֲבִיאֵ֔ם וְלֹ֥א יִמָּצֵ֖א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·šî·ḇō·w·ṯîm mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim ū·mê·’aš·šūr ’ă·qab·bə·ṣêm wə·’el- ’e·reṣ gil·‘āḏ ū·lə·ḇā·nō·wn ’ă·ḇî·’êm wə·lō yim·mā·ṣê lā·hem
verses.literal: I will bring them back from Egypt and gather them from Assyria I will bring them to Gilead and Lebanon until no more room is found for them

verses.original: וְעָבַ֨ר בַּיָּ֜ם צָרָ֗ה וְהִכָּ֤ה בַיָּם֙ גַּלִּ֔ים וְהֹבִ֕ישׁוּ כֹּ֖ל מְצוּל֣וֹת יְאֹ֑ר וְהוּרַד֙ גְּא֣וֹן אַשּׁ֔וּר וְשֵׁ֥בֶט מִצְרַ֖יִם יָסֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·ḇar bay·yām ṣā·rāh wə·hik·kāh ḇay·yām gal·lîm wə·hō·ḇî·šū kōl mə·ṣū·lō·wṯ yə·’ōr wə·hū·raḏ gə·’ō·wn ’aš·šūr wə·šê·ḇeṭ miṣ·ra·yim yā·sūr
verses.literal: They will pass through the sea of distress and strike the waves of the sea all the depths of the Nile will dry up The pride of Assyria will be brought down and the scepter of Egypt will depart

verses.original: וְגִבַּרְתִּים֙ בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וּבִשְׁמ֖וֹ יִתְהַלָּ֑כוּ נְאֻ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡib·bar·tîm Yah·weh ū·ḇiš·mōw yiṯ·hal·lā·ḵū nə·’um Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will strengthen them in the LORD and in His name they will walk declares the LORD
